reuse.why: The API model calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount with the raw _amount, so missing, number and range are handled by the helper the rest of the code already uses.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated, and the expected-amount rule stays in one helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where every other API schedule field is mapped.

scope.why: The change is focused, apart from an unrelated reformatting of the ternary inside getScheduledAmount.

maintainability.why: It adds one line that delegates to the canonical helper, plus a typed field and a test.
